semiconductor_relevance: High — Applied Seals specializes in elastomeric sealing solutions specifically designed for semiconductor applications.
summary: Applied Seals Co., Ltd. manufactures advanced elastomeric sealing products, including semiconductor-grade perfluoroelastomer compounds and O-rings, tailored for high-demand environments. Their products are designed to prevent leaks and withstand harsh conditions in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
technical_expertise: Sealing technology for high-temperature and aggressive environments

regional_presence.Taiwan: Applied Seals has a manufacturing presence in Taiwan, focusing on high-quality elastomer products for various industries.
